Package index

Creating plots

plot2() creates a complete plot from data in one call. Its methods accept data frames, vectors, tables, formulas, matrices, models and geographic data. add_type() and its shortcuts add layers to a plot.

plot2()
Conveniently Create a New ggplot
plot2(<default>) plot2(<formula>) plot2(<freq>) plot2(<sf>) plot2(<data.frame>) plot2(<matrix>)
Methods for plot2()
add_type() add_line() add_point() add_col() add_errorbar() add_smooth() add_sf()
Add Plot Element

Changing plots

Change the mapping or the order of the layers of an existing plot, or use the coordinate system of spider plots.

add_mapping()
Add Additional Mapping
move_layer()
Move a ggplot Layer
coord_spider() CoordSpider
Spider (Radar) Coordinate System for ggplot2

Colours

Get colours from names and palettes, and register the colours of an organisation for use in all plots.

dplyr and tidyselect functions

These are functions from dplyr and tidyselect that can be used in plot2() directly, without the need to load those packages first.

reexports %>% n n_distinct case_when recode_values replace_values everything starts_with ends_with matches where first last all_of any_of
